entries.title: C1+ rollout CLI should refuse overwriting an existing evidence report without --force or version by timestamp
entries.detail: The fixed-path evidence report is overwritten on each run; for real-LLM C1+ stages this must be append-only or versioned.

entries.title: Manifest/code chaos category naming alignment
entries.detail: scope_manifest.json chaos_categories now lists the 8 granular names matching rollout_chaos._CHAOS_CATEGORIES; retained as a hygiene reminder to keep manifest and driver in lockstep.

entries.title: Driver invariant output now names all 7 manifest invariants plus per-event exactly-once entries
entries.detail: Future stages should keep the manifest-to-report mapping one-to-one; automated schema lint recommended for C1+.

entries.title: offline_only is asserted, not runtime-enforced
entries.detail: The driver structurally uses fake providers and temp-rooted stores; a stronger guard (network/import audit or sandbox) may be added before C1 real-LLM stages.
